description: DRILL DOWN to the people: General Partner profiles for a fund you already identified. Use this when the question is who to approach and what they personally focus on, rather than what the fund does. COST: included in Pro, or €0.10 per call over MPP if you have no key. A fund with no published GP data returns not_found before any payment. Requires a slug from search_funds.
